description: Reply, Reply all, Forward and New message all end in a compose surface that no board draws.
expected: A compose board with To, Cc/Bcc reveal, Subject, From picker, body, attachments, Send, Cancel with keep-draft choice, sending state and an error banner, for outer, inner and half-folded layouts.
actual: Only the Compose and Reply buttons exist (Sheet.dc.html, PG-A-InboxMessage.dc.html). The sheet, its fields and its result copy (sent, unknown, reconnect, disabled, failed) are not drawn.
suggested_fix: Add a PG-A-Compose board and one rule card; draw the six outcome states.
note: PG-A-Compose draws New message, Reply and the Reply/Reply all/Forward title menu with From, To, Cc/Bcc, Subject, body, attachment, Send, Close. Remaining outcome states split into F-inbox-computer-R1-002.

story_id: STORY-056, STORY-057, STORY-058, STORY-061, STORY-062, STORY-063, STORY-066
description: Every Inbox board is the Duo outer display (466x678) or the inner display. The standard iPhone Inbox list, message and entry from Home have no board.
expected: A standard-width iPhone Inbox list and message layout with its top bar, because 7 stories name it as the device.
actual: Sheet.dc.html and PG-A-InboxMessage.dc.html show a left strip that does not exist on a standard iPhone.
suggested_fix: Add standard-iPhone Inbox list and message boards, or state that the Duo layout is the only target for phase 6.
note: PH-Inbox now draws the standard iPhone Inbox list with sections, chips, unread dots and swipe. Message view and Ask Inbox agent at 393 pt split into F-inbox-computer-R1-001.

description: The Cleanup flow (sender list, action menu, confirmations, unsubscribe results, history, Undo) and its entry point are not drawn. The outer strip has no More group, so there is no place for the Expo 'Cleanup' item.
expected: Entry point plus Cleanup list, action bar, confirm dialogs and history/Undo.
actual: NO BOARD. The 18-step story has no designed screen.
suggested_fix: Decide whether Cleanup is in phase 6; if so draw it and add a More group to the Inbox strip.
note: PG-A-Cleanup draws the More menu entry, senders ticked, bulk action menu and Done with Undo. Remaining gaps split into R1-003 and R1-004.

description: No Inbox state exists for mail writes off, reconnect needed, rate limited, no mail account ('Connect mail'), triage blocked or consent needed. 'Inbox zero' would mislead a user with no account.
expected: Inline banner or empty state per condition with a Reconnect or Connect mail action; 'Inbox zero' only for a synced, empty inbox.
actual: PG-A-Rules 'Inbox' lists only Inbox zero, loading and 'Could not load mail.'
suggested_fix: Draw the five states and the first-sync loading state.
note: Still open: PG-A-Rules Inbox card lists only Inbox zero, loading and 'Could not load mail.' No reconnect, writes-off, no-account or consent state on any board.

description: A failed swipe Archive, an accidental Archive (no Undo toast) and a failed to-do check have no designed feedback, although the API supports undo.
expected: Row returns with a visible error; a toast with Undo after Archive.
actual: Toast specimen exists in DS-04 but is not applied to mail; no failure state for the swipe.
suggested_fix: Add an Undo toast and a row-failure state to the Swipe actions specimen.
note: Still open: DS-05 swipe specimen and DS-04 toast have no Undo after Archive and no failed-row state.

description: The swipe specimen offers Star and Mute, but the API has no star write and Mute has no stated mapping. The Expo row menu offers Spam and Trash, which the specimen omits.
expected: Swipe and long-press menus list only actions the backend supports, with Spam and Trash reachable.
actual: Swipe specimen shows Archive, Star, Mute, Mark read.
suggested_fix: Drop Star until a write exists; map Mute to inbox.feedback or remove it; add Spam and Trash to the long-press menu.
note: Still open: DS-05 swipe spec still lists Star and Mute (bell.slash) and no Spam/Trash. PH-Inbox shows only Archive, which now disagrees with the spec.

description: The Inbox control set differs per board: Sheet has Search as an icon and no Hide amounts; Split has an inline search field plus Hide amounts (eye) and Important only (star); DS-04 says Filter lives in More while Sheet puts it in the strip. Hide amounts has no amounts to hide on mail. Filter options (Needs reply, Newsletters, Read mail) do not match the Expo categories.
expected: One Inbox control set across all boards, matching the rule card, with only actions that apply to mail.
actual: Three different sets are drawn.
suggested_fix: Remove the eye from Inbox; pick one place for Filter and Important only; align filter options with InboxFilter values.
note: Still open: Split still draws eye and star; Sheet has search, filter, compose; PH-Inbox same plus none; Cleanup panel adds More. DS-04 filter options still Needs reply, Newsletters, Read mail.

description: The message board has only Archive and Reply in the strip. Forward and Reply all have no control, so the 6-step Forward path starts with a hunt for an entry point.
expected: Reply group or menu that offers Reply, Reply all, Forward.
actual: Strip draws Archive and Reply only.
suggested_fix: Make Reply a pull-down menu with three items, or add Forward to the long-press menu and draw it.
note: Forward and Reply all are reachable from the Reply title menu drawn in PG-A-Compose. Discoverability (menu only after opening Reply) is R1-005.

description: The mail approval card is drawn three ways: 'Send reply' with Deny/Allow (PG-A-Thread), 're: Pilot timeline' with Save/Send (Inner), and 'view draft' then Send in the catalog.
expected: One card with one pair of actions and one label for the draft.
actual: Titles, buttons and available actions differ.
suggested_fix: Pick one card in DS-06 and redraw the two boards from it.
note: PG-A-Thread and Inner now draw the same card: 'Re: Pilot timeline', Needs approval, Save and Send.

description: The same icon-only prominent button (bubble.left) means 'Ask Inbox agent', 'Open chat' and 'Open conversation', and on Agent list the same icon is an ordinary button. The catalog names text labels that the boards never show.
expected: Distinct accessible names and, where space allows, a label or tooltip; one meaning per icon.
actual: Four screens draw an identical glyph with different meanings.
suggested_fix: Specify VoiceOver labels per screen in the rule cards; use a different glyph for 'Open conversation' on the routine.
note: Still open: PG-A-Rules still gives SF bubble.left to Ask Inbox agent, Open chat and Open conversation.

description: No attachment preview screen, no multi-message thread layout, no Unsubscribe on the message, no error state for Ask Inbox agent failing.
expected: Preview, thread and failure states drawn.
actual: Message board shows one message and two attachment rows.
suggested_fix: Add a thread variant and an attachment preview board.
note: Still open: PG-A-InboxMessage unchanged (one message, two attachment rows, no Unsubscribe, no agent failure state).

description: In Sheet, unread rows show a filled dot at the left and a second small bullet before the snippet; Inner and Split use '-' separators and label chips (Needs attention, Newsletter, Junk), which Sheet omits. Row anatomy is not the same across boards.
expected: One mail row anatomy: unread dot, sender, time, subject, snippet, optional label chip.
actual: Two dots on one row and chips missing on Sheet.
suggested_fix: Remove the snippet bullet and add the chips to Sheet.
note: Still open: Sheet still has a dot plus a second bullet per unread row and no label chips; PH-Inbox and Split show chips and a single dot.

description: The To do card exists only as a specimen; no Inbox board places it on top of the list, and the story is entirely off-board on the screen level.
expected: Inbox board with the To do card above Needs reply and its hide-when-empty rule.
actual: Card appears in DS-05 only.
suggested_fix: Add the card to the standard Inbox list board.
note: Still open: PH-Inbox, Sheet and Split draw no To do card above the list.

description: The inner Inbox boards do not draw the message detail pane, the compose pane, the empty (Inbox zero) detail, or the folders in the 1/3 sidebar. Inner shows the agent thread whose strip has Page and List but no Archive, Reply, Back or prominent action.
expected: Detail pane states for message, compose, agent thread and empty, with the strip that applies to each.
actual: One state is drawn.
suggested_fix: Draw message-selected and empty detail on Inner and name what the strip holds for each.
note: Still open: Inner shows the agent thread beside the list; no message pane, compose pane or folders.

description: Team Computer draws only the 'in control' state. Booting progress, view-only with Take control, the Skip / I'm done handoff, lease expiry, Reconnecting, takeover denied, 'Could not open computer' and 'Could not load the desktop.' have no board, and the key bar has no Return key although step 10 submits a login with Return.
expected: Each state drawn from the same layout, a Return key on the key bar.
actual: PG-A-Computer.png shows Team/Private, 'You have control', Esc Tab Ctrl and arrows.
suggested_fix: Draw boot, watch, handoff prompt and error states; add Return to the key bar.
note: Partly addressed: PH-Computer draws Watching with Take control and In control with Release. Still missing: booting, Skip / I'm done handoff, lease expiry, reconnecting, takeover denied, load error.

description: The Computer board has six glass elements: Close group, Keyboard/Fit group, Team/Private picker, control chip, key bar, plus the prominent Release. README allows at most three glass groups.
expected: At most three glass groups plus one prominent action.
actual: Six.
suggested_fix: Merge picker and chip into one clear capsule and fold Keyboard/Fit into the key bar, or document the exception for clear glass over media.
note: Still open: PH-Computer in control shows close, status chip, keyboard, Release and the key bar (five floating groups); PG-A-Computer has six. README allows three.

description: The Artifact board draws Share as an ordinary glass button and has no prominent action. The rule card and catalog both say Share is the prominent action.
expected: One tinted prominent action per view: Share.
actual: No ink-filled button; the bottom-left control is an ordinary More button.
suggested_fix: Move Share to the prominent slot at the bottom of the strip.
note: Still open: PG-A-Artifact has no prominent action; Share is an ordinary glass button while the rule card says Share is prominent.

description: Artifact repeats the name 'Runway summary' in the title capsule and as the card heading. The version is switchable from both the Versions button and the pill chevrons.
expected: Say each thing once: one title; one way to switch versions.
actual: Both duplicates drawn.
suggested_fix: Drop the card heading or the capsule; keep the pill and make Versions a list menu only if the pill cannot jump.
note: Still open: 'Runway summary' appears in the capsule and the card heading; version switch exists in both the Versions button and the pill.

description: Versions menu, delete confirmation (with version count), Save to Photos success/denied feedback, and the contents of the More menus on Artifact and Image are not drawn. 'Save to Photos' is an unlabeled photo glyph beside Share.
expected: Each menu and dialog drawn, labels or accessible names given.
actual: Rule cards describe them in text only.
suggested_fix: Add the versions menu, delete alert and Photos toast to DS-04 and reference them.
note: Still open: no Versions menu, delete confirmation, Save to Photos feedback or More menu contents drawn.

description: On the Agent page the three figure tiles have unequal widths (116, 151 and 85 px); the Runway tile is the narrowest and sits tight against the right edge.
expected: Equal-width tiles with the same inner padding.
actual: Cash 116, Burn 151, Runway 85.
suggested_fix: Make the three tiles flex: 1 so they share width equally.
note: PG-A-AgentPage tiles are now 116, 118 and 116 px wide; geometry audit clean.

description: The Routine board shows one routine only. There is no routines list (the inner third), no run history, no failed or paused state, and 'Open conversation' does not say which run.
expected: Routines list, status with last-run result, history.
actual: Status card and prompt only.
suggested_fix: Draw the list and a failed-run status; say which run the conversation belongs to.
note: Still open: PG-A-Routine unchanged (one routine, no list, history or failed state).

description: Agent page, Agent list, Routine and the desktop error have text but no retry control and no offline or stale-data indicator; each screen recovers only by going back.
expected: A retry on every error line.
actual: Only Artifacts and Computer have retry.
suggested_fix: Add 'Try again.' to the four error states and draw one offline banner.
note: Still open: PG-A-Rules Agent page, list, routine and computer errors still have text only and no retry.

description: The Agent list has no design for the conflict alert ('The bot changed this list'), delete affordance, or keyboard covering the Add item field.
expected: Conflict, delete and keyboard states drawn.
actual: Rows and field only.
suggested_fix: Add swipe-to-delete and the conflict alert.
note: Still open: PG-A-AgentList has no conflict alert, delete affordance or keyboard state.

description: The standard iPhone entry to Artifacts is undefined, and the Artifacts chip row is cut at the right edge with no overflow hint or fade; search is an icon with no expanded state.
expected: Entry point, scroll hint and expanded search drawn.
actual: Chip row ends at the edge with 'Inbox agent' off screen.
suggested_fix: Draw the expanded search and a trailing fade on the chips.
note: Still open: Artifacts chip row still runs off the right edge ('Chief' clipped) with no fade; standard iPhone Artifacts has no board.

description: Only Finance is drawn in laptop pose (Desk.dc.html). Computer, Artifact, Agent page, Agent list and Image laptop layouts, and the move between a laptop-capable and a full-height screen (Routine, Artifacts), have no board.
expected: Boards or an explicit statement for the five laptop layouts and transitions.
actual: Rule cards describe them; none drawn.
suggested_fix: Draw Computer in laptop pose first, as the rule card calls it the main use.
note: Still open: Desk.dc.html still draws only Finance in laptop pose.

story_id: STORY-067, STORY-069, STORY-070, STORY-071, STORY-072, STORY-074, STORY-077
description: Seven stories use a standard iPhone for Computer, Artifacts, Artifact, Image and Agent list, but all boards are Duo outer. Close, Keyboard, Fit to screen and Take control placement on a 393 pt width is undefined.
expected: Standard iPhone variants or an explicit rule for deriving them.
actual: Left-strip layout only.
suggested_fix: Add a standard-width recipe to PG-A-Rules and one drawn example.
note: Partly addressed: PH-Computer covers Computer at 393 pt. Artifacts, Artifact, Image, Agent page, Agent list and Routine still have only the Duo outer board.

description: Names differ between boards, plan and Expo: 'Other mail today' vs Today/Earlier, 'Ask Inbox agent' vs 'Ask agent', 'open computer' (lowercase in the rule card) vs 'Open computer'.
expected: One name per concept.
actual: Several variants.
suggested_fix: Pick the board names and update the catalog and plan.
note: Still open: 'Other mail today' on boards vs Today/Earlier in PH-Inbox; PH-Computer says 'In control', PG-A-Computer 'You have control'.

description: Runway figures appear on the Finance page, the Runway summary artifact, the agent page and the routine prompt with no link between them, and the agent page bullets ('4 card expenses need receipts') are not tappable.
expected: One designed jump from finding to source.
actual: Four copies, no links.
suggested_fix: Make bullets link to the relevant screen, or drop duplicated tiles.
note: Still open (suggestion): runway figures repeat on four screens.

description: PH-Inbox has no 'Ask Inbox agent' button and no standard iPhone message or compose board, so on a 393 pt phone the user cannot see how to reach the agent or read a message.
suggested_fix: Add the prominent Ask Inbox agent control to PH-Inbox (or say compose stays the single prominent action and the agent is in More) and add PH message and compose boards.
note: New in round 1.

description: Compose draws only the happy editing state. No empty/disabled Send, sending, sent, failed, unknown result (never auto-retry), mail writes off, reconnect needed, or discard-draft choice on Close.
suggested_fix: Add one row of states under the three panels: Send disabled, Sending, error banner with Retry, unknown, writes off, and a Close action sheet with Keep draft / Discard.
note: New in round 1.

description: Cleanup shows ticked senders and a Done state only. No confirmation before Unsubscribe or Archive on many senders, no per-sender unsubscribe result or failure, no loading, empty ('nothing to clean up') or history view.
suggested_fix: Draw loading, empty, confirm dialog, partial failure with Retry, and where history lives.
note: New in round 1.

description: Cleanup is entered through a More group, which only the Cleanup board's first panel draws. Sheet and PH-Inbox have no More control, so Cleanup is unreachable on those boards.
suggested_fix: Add the same More control to Sheet and PH-Inbox, or move Cleanup to the filter menu and redraw the first panel.
note: New in round 1.

description: Forward and Reply all are reachable only after opening Reply and then the title chevron. The message board's single Reply button gives no hint that it leads to a menu.
suggested_fix: Add a chevron or long-press hint on the message Reply button, or draw the three-item menu on the message board.
note: New in round 1.
